newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LIETUVA POSTS 614,000 LITAS H1 97 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LIETUVA POSTS 614,000 LITAS H1 97 PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's biggest hotel the Lietuva said on Monday that its net profit in the first half of the year fell to 614,000 litas from 662,000 litas in the same period of 1996.

Hotel finance officer, Eugenija Krivoshejeva, also told Reuters that the hotel's turnover in the first half of the year was 5.3 million litas, a decrease from 5.6 million litas in the same period in 1996.
The major reason behind the lower profit figure and turnover was that the hotel rented out three bars of the hotel to private companies, Kirvoshejeva said.
She added that the hotel's room occupancy rate was 28.5 percent in the first half of 1997 versus 26.2 percent in the same period in 1996.
The hotel reported a net profit of 817,000 litas and turnover of 10.7 million litas for 1996.
Lithuania's government slated the Soviet-style skyscraper for privatisation and said it intends to announce an international bid in the near future.
The hotel is 70.04 percent state-run and is listed in the group A of the Vilnius bourse.
